Gutters questions: materials, installation and estimates
Can one damaged section be replaced?

Possibly, when retained components are serviceable and the connection can be restored. The material, profile, finish and cause of damage all need to be considered. Confirm the repair option available for your system.
Do larger gutters automatically fix overflow?
No. Blockage, outlets, downspouts and discharge can still cause problems. The arrangement needs to address the source of the overflow as a whole.
Are gutters with guards maintenance-free?
No. Inspection and cleaning requirements depend on the system, debris and surrounding conditions. Follow the selected manufacturer's instructions and have persistent overflow assessed.
